onlineSources.finding: Unity documents shader prewarming and recommends collecting/loading GraphicsStateCollection data for modern graphics APIs when exact PSO warmup is needed.
Progressive SVC warmup can spread work over frames but is not full modern-API PSO proof by itself.
ShaderWarmup.WarmupShaderFromCollection requires a rendering setup, including vertex declaration, for variants in a collection.
GraphicsStateCollection is a Unity 6 collection of shader variants plus associated graphics states, with WarmUpProgressively creating GPU representations for recorded shader-state permutations.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Ring readiness could be inferred from nonzero BufferID after a failed lock/validation attempt.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added _shaderWarmupTelemetryReady and validation through TryAcquireWriteLock/finally ReleaseWriteLock.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Single P/N/T/UV0 ShaderWarmupSetup did not cover HUD/UI vertex layout states.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added mesh and HUD/UI ShaderWarmupSetup records and warmed each manifest shader through both.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Fixed 5000ms timeout could false-fail low-tier cadence and optional PSO traces.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added ResolveShaderWarmupTimeoutMilliseconds with manifest/setup/PSO budgets and continuous GlobalQualityWeight padding.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: PassType.Meta consumed strict SVC compiler budget despite being lightmap/editor metadata.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Removed PassType.Meta and added runtimePassBudgetOnly=true to compiler report.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Empty .graphicsstate load could create a GraphicsStateCollection then return false without destruction.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Destroy and null empty or partially created GraphicsStateCollection objects on fail-closed load.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Dump route could mark queued without writing a black-box file when Vault/ring lock was unavailable.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added 64B MissingTelemetryRing fallback dump header.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Scanner pulse shader was not in active bootstrap SVC/manifest.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added Hecton_ScannerPulseInstanced to SuitVisor_HUDPhosphor.shadervariants and scene shaderWarmupShaders.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Direct HUD/scanner shader roots could be starved by material variants under MaxCompiledVariants.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: DirectShaderReferenceRoots are emitted first.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Tests only spot-checked GUIDs.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added full SVC shader GUID coverage test and CLI mirror.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: DX12/Vulkan/Metal could enter simulation with zero configured .graphicsstate traces even though SVC warmup is not exact PSO proof for those APIs.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added RequiresGraphicsStateCollectionsForCurrentApi and MissingGraphicsStateCollections fail-closed telemetry before SVC traversal.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: The two warmup vertex declarations did not cover real project layouts for scanner quads, HUD quads, VFX trails with float Color, P+N cubes, and voxel meshes with TexCoord1..4.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Expanded prebuilt ShaderWarmupSetup records to mesh P/N/T/UV0, P/UV0, P/N, P/N/UV0, UI Color UNorm8, float Color, and voxel P/N/Color/TexCoord1..4 layouts.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Shader warmup black-box dump wrote directly to Dump_1336_Bootstrapper.bin, leaving a partial final file possible if the worker failed mid-write.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Worker now writes Dump_1336_Bootstrapper.bin.tmp through AsyncWriteManager and promotes with File.Replace/File.Move only after the temp write succeeds.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Hecton8_UberNoir_RadiationWarmup.shadervariants existed on disk but was not referenced by 00_BOOTSTRAP, and its shader GUID was missing from shaderWarmupShaders.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added the radiation SVC GUID and Hecton8_UberNoir shader GUID to the bootstrap scene and prioritized the shader plus INSTANCING_ON/DOTS_INSTANCING_ON in the compiler.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Timeout calculation counted warmup attempts but undercounted wall-clock yielded frames after coverage expanded to 8 SVCs, 15 manifest shaders, and 7 layouts.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Timeout now includes quality-scaled frame-slice cadence, collection-yield frames, and a 60s upper bound to prevent false low-tier boot failure.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: The .graphicsstate loader accepted generic Assets/... and ProjectSettings/... paths as normal runtime configuration. That can pass in Editor but fail in a player build where those project folders do not exist.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Replaced the raw resolver with TryResolveGraphicsStateCollectionPath: .graphicsstate extension required, parent traversal rejected, Assets/StreamingAssets normalized to Application.streamingAssetsPath, and Assets/ProjectSettings paths allowed only under UNITY_EDITOR. Player absolute paths must resolve under StreamingAssets.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Warmup only checked shaderWarmupShaders.Length. If Unity import/GUID damage produced a non-empty array of null shader references, the bootstrapper could warn and still report success with zero real ShaderWarmup calls.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added CountValidShaderWarmupShaders and fail-closed MissingShaderManifest before warmup when no non-null shader references exist. Timeout and start telemetry now use the valid shader count.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: The edit test proved collection shader GUID membership but did not prove scene shader manifest GUIDs resolve to actual Shader assets.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: BootstrapScene_ShaderManifestCoversEveryConfiguredCollection now resolves every manifest shader GUID to a UnityEngine.Shader and every configured collection GUID to a UnityEngine.ShaderVariantCollection.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Loop 18 blocked all-null shader manifests, but a partially null shader manifest or null SVC slot could still produce warning telemetry and continue if other entries were valid.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added exact null-slot scans for shaderVariantCollections and shaderWarmupShaders. Any null configured collection now fails closed with MissingShaderCollections; any null shader slot fails closed with MissingShaderManifest before PSO/SVC warmup.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: TryResolveStreamingAssetsPath trusted caller-side slash normalization. A direct backslash relative path on Windows could bypass HasParentPathSegment if the helper were reused.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: TryResolveStreamingAssetsPath now normalizes backslashes itself, rejects parent segments on the normalized value, resolves a full path under Application.streamingAssetsPath, and verifies the final absolute path starts with the StreamingAssets root.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: After null manifests became fail-closed, private NullCollection/NullShader warning flags and Bootstrap.ShaderWarmup.Warning hash remained as stale schema surface.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Removed the stale null warning flags, Warning phase entry, and warning hash so null manifests cannot be reintroduced as warning-only telemetry without an explicit code diff.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: StreamingAssets root checks used OrdinalIgnoreCase on every platform. Linux/macOS/Steam Deck filesystems are case-sensitive, so a case-insensitive prefix check is the wrong root proof.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added ResolvePathStringComparison: Windows Editor/Player uses OrdinalIgnoreCase; all other platforms use Ordinal.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Unity documents Android/WebGL StreamingAssets paths as URL/JAR-backed. The .graphicsstate loader expected filesystem paths and could fail only by incidental Path/File exceptions.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added TryGetStreamingAssetsFileSystemRoot and IsUrlLikePath. URL/JAR StreamingAssets paths now fail closed deterministically before GraphicsStateCollection load.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: A configured URL-like .graphicsstate path could fall through as a malformed relative StreamingAssets filename before File.Exists failed.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: TryResolveGraphicsStateCollectionPath now rejects IsUrlLikePath(configuredPath), and TryResolveStreamingAssetsPath rejects IsUrlLikePath(normalizedRelativePath).

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: WarmConfiguredGraphicsStateCollectionsAsync destroyed a loaded GraphicsStateCollection after awaiting warmup, but the destroy was not in a finally block.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Wrapped WarmLoadedGraphicsStateCollectionAsync await in try/finally so UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(collection) runs on failure or unexpected unwind without adding catch-based control flow.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Rooted Editor .graphicsstate paths could point outside the repository/project, creating false local PSO proof that CI and player packaging do not own.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Added TryGetProjectFileSystemRoot. Rooted Editor paths and generic Assets/ProjectSettings paths now require the resolved full path to remain under the project root.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: A .graphicsstate file could be deleted, denied, or become unsupported between File.Exists and GraphicsStateCollection construction, allowing IO/access exceptions to escape the fail-closed loader.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: TryLoadGraphicsStateCollection now catches IOException, UnauthorizedAccessException, and NotSupportedException, destroys any partial object, nulls the out parameter, and returns false.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Roslyn audit over Assets/_Project/Scripts/Bootstrap found BootstrapEvents._pendingEvents and _nextFrameEvents as static NativeQueue<BootstrapEventPayload> fields in a long-lived coordinator.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: BootstrapEventPayload now implements ISignal. BootstrapEvents publishes through SignalBus<BootstrapEventPayload>.TryPushTracked and drains GetFrameSnapshot; the static NativeQueue fields and sentinel registration/disposal were removed.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: BootstrapEvents.FlushPending still isolated every listener with catch (Exception) and H8Debug.LogException after the NativeQueue purge.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Removed DispatchToListener, broad catch, exception counters, and exception logging. FlushPending now dispatches directly from the bounded SignalBus snapshot loop.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: GameBootstrapper still owned a private managed BootstrapEventQueue with GameBootstrapperEventPayload[] _items for ready/failure publication.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: GameBootstrapperEventPayload now implements ISignal. Ready/failure publication uses SignalBus<GameBootstrapperEventPayload>.TryPushTracked and FlushPendingEvents drains GetFrameSnapshot while preserving IGameBootstrapperEventListener.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: GameBootstrapper.Register/Unregister could mutate the public listener facade while FlushPendingEvents was dispatching OnGameBootstrapperEvent callbacks.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Register/Unregister now defer mutations into fixed ListenerSlot buffers while dispatch is active, and FlushPendingEvents applies them in finally after each payload.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: RunBackgroundDomainHandshakeAsync used broad catch (Exception), stored a managed _backgroundDomainHandshakeError string, and JoinBackgroundDomainHandshakeAsync concatenated it into a development log while also using exception-driven cancellation.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Replaced managed error string with numeric _backgroundDomainHandshakeFailureCode, moved directory preparation into TryPrepareBackgroundDomainHandshake typed failure-code helper, and changed JoinBackgroundDomainHandshakeAsync to ct.IsCancellationRequested plus non-tokenized NextFrameAsync.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: 00_BOOTSTRAP configured Hecton8MasterVariants, but the asset contained m_Shaders: [] and GameBootstrapper skipped empty configured collections instead of failing the warmup contract.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Hecton8MasterVariants now contains the 15 first-20-minute manifest shaders and 18 variants; GameBootstrapper rejects any configured ShaderVariantCollection with variantCount <= 0 through InvalidCollectionSet before simulation can start.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: Runtime warmup iterates collectionCount * shaderWarmupShaders * ShaderWarmupSetup. Keeping eight scene SVCs forced repeated no-op shader/setup attempts and inflated low-tier boot cadence.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: 00_BOOTSTRAP now wires one non-empty master SVC; per-feature SVC files remain as source artifacts, but runtime warmup uses one authoritative collection and still validates every shader GUID in the manifest.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: DirectShaderKeywordEntry only represented one keyword, so authored shaders with both multi_compile_instancing and DOTS_INSTANCING_ON could miss the combined DOTS+instancing permutation.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Editor compiler DirectShaderKeywordEntry now stores sorted params string[] Keywords and emits DOTS_INSTANCING_ON + INSTANCING_ON for Hecton8_UberNoir. The master SVC and radiation SVC include the combined keyword line.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: InitializePresentationBootstrapAsync still used tokenized AwaitableDebtMonitor.NextFrameAsync calls under catch (OperationCanceledException) around the shader warmup gate.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Presentation bootstrap now uses ct.IsCancellationRequested checks and non-tokenized NextFrameAsync in the 1336 gate, returning false instead of using cancellation exceptions as normal control flow.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: The editor compiler could regenerate Hecton8MasterVariants without consuming 00_BOOTSTRAP.shaderWarmupShaders, letting the master SVC drift away from the runtime-owned manifest.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: HectonShaderVariantCollectionCompiler1336 now parses the scene shaderWarmupShaders GUID block, resolves shader paths through AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath, promotes them into priorityShaderPaths, and reports sceneShaderManifestIncluded=true.

defectsFoundAndHandled.finding: The scene YAML interval used for shader manifest proof also contains runtimeShaderReferenceCatalog, so any all-GUID extractor could treat a ScriptableObject catalog GUID as a shader.
defectsFoundAndHandled.fix: Compiler now requires fileID: 4800000 through TryExtractShaderReferenceGuid. Tests use ExtractSceneShaderGuids and assert the RuntimeShaderReferenceCatalog GUID does not leak into shader proof.
